sections.name: Your hands, about 5 minutes at the PC, Unreal closed. Since the Epic launcher began moving Unreal to 5.8.4 on 9 November, its optional MetaHuman content is missing, so Ron, Sheila and Darren lost their standing idle in the night walks. Steps: open the Epic Games Launcher, Unreal Engine, Library. On the 5.8 tile click the yellow Resume button first and wait until it reads Launch (the update never finished, so Options is hidden until then). Then the small arrow, Options; tick every box that mentions MetaHuman, and Engine Source; never tick Editor symbols for debugging (tens of GB). Apply, then tap Done here.
sections.recommendation: Do it when you are next at the PC: it brings back the people's approved idle and the engine source the session checks engine questions against.
